description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Notification Under Section 2(3)(b) of the Statute No. 2 of 2011 regarding Powers to monitor administration in Local Government Authorities Established in Uva Province
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Governor of Uva Province exercising powers related to monitoring administration in local government authorities, specifically the cancellation of a previous notification regarding the Kandaketiya Pradeshiya Sabha. The content focuses on judicial investigation, administrative oversight of local government bodies, and the exercise of statutory powers by a provincial governor. This falls under Judicial/Law Enforcement (Type 9) as it deals with law enforcement regulations, procedures, and administrative oversight of local government authorities rather than central government structure or personnel changes.
